====================================================
AUDIO PLACEMENT INSTRUCTIONS
====================================================

Place your background MP3 audio files in this directory:

1. wedding.mp3 -> Main Invitation & Welcome Song (Cover, Welcome & Events pages)
2. tilak.mp3   -> Tilak Ceremony Background Song
3. haldi.mp3   -> Haldi Ceremony Background Song
4. mehandi.mp3 -> Mehandi Ceremony Background Song
5. barat.mp3   -> Barat Ceremony Background Song
6. vidai.mp3   -> Vidai Ceremony Background Song

Note: If an audio file is missing or still loading, the built-in Web Audio Shehnai Ambient Synthesizer automatically plays traditional Indian harmonies so music never fails!
